# Deck

## What the composites share

Both composites are Titan Warriors lunging with Blood Hunt on a spear, Bloodlust in its group and Herald of Blood for the bleeding dead; the brief fixes that identity, so they differ by engine.

## How they differ

"Bleed Burst Lancer" runs on bleed from on-hit: every hit builds Blood Loss for the lunge, with armour on every slot; "Rage-Fed Lunger" runs on rage from on-hit: the rage wheel turns each hit into a bigger lunge, and Herald of Blood is kept for packs.

## The obvious build

- r1-a-1 "Blood Hunt bleed burst" | the melee kit for a spear lunge: bleed supports on the lunge, life and armour on the gear

## Round 1

- r1-s-1 "Bleed Burst Lancer" | bleed from on-hit | the lunge's hit, its Blood Loss burst, Herald of Blood's explosions | Blood Loss built by every hit, so the burst never waits | under-played (judgment: armour stacking on a spear lunge, which few lunge builds take)
- r1-s-2 "Rage-Fed Lunger" | rage from on-hit | the lunge's hit, its Blood Loss burst | rage built on every hit, refilled by the rage wheel | under-played (judgment: rage cycling on a bleed lunge, rarely built)
